The '''Resource Recon Speeder''' was a model from [[SoroSuub Corporation/Legends|SoroSuub Corporation]]. It was five meters long and could hover five meters above the surface. It carried two crew (a pilot and a [[Sensor/Legends|sensor]] operator), two passengers, and 70 kilograms of cargo. It cost 30,000 [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]] new. Its sensors could be used to locate resources for mining and to make maps of areas traversed. [[Lant Mining Corporation]] used them for these purposes and to direct fleets of [[Multi-Environment Mining Droid MEMD-2]]s.
